what.text: This page follows refugees from Tajikistan in Uzbekistan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year from 1995 to 2005.
At the end of 2005, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 39202 refugees, 71.6% of all Tajik refugees that year.
Today refugees from Tajikistan live mostly in Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tajikistan from 1992 to 1998, at war level in some of those years, and again in 2000 and from 2010 to 2011.
The opponents it records include the Forces of Mullo Abdullo in 2000 and from 2010 to 2011.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 5 refugees.
The figure reached its highest level from 2002 to 2005, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they lived in Uzbekistan.
These are year-end totals for Uzbekistan only, reported to UNHCR, and the series ends in 2005.
